name: Potol Kumar Gaanwala
description: Potol, a singing prodigy, lives in a village with her mother, uncle and aunt. However, after her mother's death, she sets out to search for her father, whose identity she does not know.

videos.title: Potol Escapes!
videos.overview: Potol is surprised as Binu helps her to escape. He blesses Potol with a bright singing career. Ratan's associates are surprised that Binu has helped Potol in escaping from them.

videos.title: Aditi lies to the Police
videos.overview: Aditi lies to the police that Potol has escaped with her jewellery. She accuses Chandan of helping Potol. Deepa and Sujon's mother tell the police that Aditi is lying, but in vain. Meanwhile, Potol narrates the incidents through her song to the people in the market.

videos.title: Sujon Questions Potol
videos.overview: Sujon becomes restless, as Potol sings Subhaga's song. Sujon questions Potol about her identity in front of the audience. Rashmoni stops Potol as she finishes the programme and plans to leave from there.

videos.title: Rashmoni Lies to Deepa
videos.overview: Deepa visits Rashmoni at the police station. Rashmoni lies to her about Potol. Deepa decides to get Rashmoni released on bail. Later, at Sujon's house, she is accused of stealing Sujon's locket.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Shubhaga and Tridha worry about Tuli's hatred towards Potol. Later, except Tuli, everyone feels happy as Potol and Sujon sing together. Watch the full episode, online only on Hotstar.

videos.title: Sujon Looks For Aditi
videos.overview: Sujon panics on not finding Aditi in the house. Rashmoni wants Potol to use her talent to earn money. Watch the full episode, online only on Hotstar.
